messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — a customer reported the Console is showing wrong cost-center for some requests after we started normalizing quota headers.

AJ: which header change? the X-Quota-Group rollout last week?

Maria: yes. We moved canonicalization to the API edge and now Console logs the raw header value, but some legacy clients still send quotaGroup in the JSON body so mapping fails.

Kevin: confirmed. A subset of older TS/Node clients serialize `quotaGroup` in the body. Edge currently prefers header, so body values get ignored unless we handle them specially.

Sachin: SDKs changed to prefer headers to avoid proxy stripping. We pushed that in the TS release but didn't fully paint the migration path to internal integrators.

Lina: Can we make the edge accept both header and body for a short grace period? Fallback priority header > body > default.

AJ: doable, but we need a canonical field for telemetry/billing. If we accept both we must tag the source so analytics can dedupe and billing gets the canonical key.

Maria: Proposal: accept both at edge, add `quota.source` telemetry with values `header` | `body` | `default`, and surface that in Console request detail. Start a 4-week migration window and send client warnings if body is used.

Kevin: SDK plan: emit a single deprecation log once per process when a client uses body-based quota. Env var to silence. Py and Go patches ready; TS needs a minor break (enum rename) — we can do a semver minor and coordinate.

DevEx: we can add a Console banner and a Doc link in the SDK messages. Also add a small tooltip explaining `quota.source`.

deploy-bot: canary deployed quota-normalizer v0.9 to eu-west-1 at 12:08 UTC :rocket:

AJ: After canary let's run a 48h sampling. Compare `quota.source` distribution and Console mapping accuracy. If mismatch >1% for active clients, rollback.

Lina: For Console UX product wants both raw and canonical visible so teams can filter while migration is ongoing. Can show raw_value, canonical_quota, and quota.source in the request detail drawer.

Maria: I'll coordinate with DevEx for tooltip copy. Also file a short customer-facing note to affected orgs.

Kevin: Billing pipeline needs canonical_quota. If we detect body-sourced values, tag events with `migrated_from_body` so downstream ETL can reconcile during the grace period.

Sachin: I'll draft SDK deprecation PRs today and include a migration snippet. Example we can use in docs:

```
# preferred (header)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "X-Quota-Group: team-frontend" \ 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-34b","input":"..."}'

# legacy (body)
POST /v1/generate
{"model":"rwd-34b","quotaGroup":"team-frontend","input":"..."}
```

AJ: I'll add `quota.source` to telemetry schema v2, and a small tile in the rollouts dashboard visualizing source splits. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Maria: Sounds good. If we keep the migration warnings visible and add the telemetry tag, we should be able to deprecate body usage after 4 weeks with minimal customer impact.

Lina: thank you — let us know if SDKs need help with release notes or staging samples. :thumbsup:

Kevin: one more note: add unit test in telemetry ETL to assert canonicalization and migrated flag logic during the migration window.

DevEx: will update the SDK quickstarts and add a migration checklist in docs.

Maria: I'll open a short internal follow-up ticket with rollout dates and affected client versions. Thanks all. :pray:
